name: ColBERT Multi-Vector Late Interaction (MaxSim) in Pure SQL
description: Advanced retrieval models (ColBERT / Sanity) represent queries and documents as collections of token vectors. Scoring computes MaxSim: for each query token, take the maximum cosine similarity across all document tokens, then sum.
prompt:
Advanced retrieval models (ColBERT / Sanity) represent queries and documents as collections of token vectors. Scoring computes MaxSim: for each query token, take the maximum cosine similarity across all document tokens, then sum.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: doc_id, colbert_maxsim_score.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- ColBERT MaxSim calculation: SUM_q( MAX_d( sim(q, d) ) )
            WITH token_sims AS (
                SELECT 
                    q.q_token_id,
                    q.token_text AS q_token,
                    d.doc_id,
                    d.token_text AS d_token,
                    array_cosine_similarity(q.vec, d.vec) AS sim
                FROM query_tokens q
                CROSS JOIN doc_token_embeddings d
            ),
            max_sim_per_query_token AS (
                SELECT 
                    doc_id,
                    q_token_id,
                    MAX(sim) AS max_token_sim
                FROM token_sims
                GROUP BY doc_id, q_token_id
            )
            SELECT 
                doc_id,
                ROUND(SUM(max_token_sim), 4) AS colbert_maxsim_score
            FROM max_sim_per_query_token
            GROUP BY doc_id
            ORDER BY colbert_maxsim_score DESC;
why_it_fails: Implementing late interaction typically requires specialized Python tensor pipelines.
